title: Umbrella C — Mechanical verification & decision provenance
body: Compose's contracts and decisions are too prose-y. Codex review catches what it catches, but a structured-table contract with grep-able axes (Truths / Artifacts / Key Links) is mechanically checkable in ways `ensure: result.tests_pass == True` is not. Same applies to architectural decisions and tool policy — each lives in scattered free text today; lifting to structured artifacts makes them auditable.
